GOAL: Make idempotent directive replay treat an already PROCESSING durable dispatch as delivered/claimed without re-enqueueing or regressing it to ENQUEUED.
SCOPE: packages/api/directives.ts only if replay caller semantics need adjustment
new focused durable dispatch lifecycle test
REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR: PROCESSING is an idempotent already-delivered/claimed state for dispatch replay and must not transition backward to ENQUEUED.
Replay must not add/retry the BullMQ job when it is already active.
Worker completion must still transition PROCESSING -> COMPLETED exactly once.
Legitimate PENDING/ENQUEUED delivery and explicit FAILED retry semantics remain intact.
Repair must be reconciled with queue CAS and authorized-retry sequencing tasks.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not introduce a generic backward transition to ENQUEUED.
Do not hide a truly FAILED or missing dispatch as PROCESSING success.
Do not mutate NEXY.ai or direct integration head while worker branch isolation is blocked.
ACCEPTANCE: Test sets durable row PROCESSING, performs same-key API replay, and proves row remains PROCESSING.
Test proves no BullMQ add/retry occurs for PROCESSING replay.
Worker completion after replay writes COMPLETED successfully.
Repeated replay remains idempotent without incrementing attempts.
Existing queue retry/cancellation/directive replay tests remain green.
Independent exact-SHA review completes after integration.
UNBLOCK_CONDITION: Authoritative policy establishes a Git-valid isolated worker branch namespace or explicitly authorizes an equivalent isolation mechanism.
